findings.title: The Profit Gap is running through your discount line
findings.evidence: 15 of your 17 live products are discounted, averaging 27.1% off. That can hold your revenue while contribution profit slips underneath it. The gap between the two is the first number RISE looks at.

findings.title: No subscribe-and-save path for repeat buyers
findings.evidence: Your storefront runs 17 products with no subscription option we could find on the page. Repeat purchases are where contribution profit compounds, and a subscribe-and-save path turns one-time buyers into predictable revenue on the traffic you already pay for.

findings.title: Your price band is wide and the median sits low
findings.evidence: Catalog runs $19.99 to $69.99 with a $49.99 median. A wide band with a low median makes blended AOV fragile on paid. The lever is threshold and bundle offers on the landing path the ads point to.

findings.title: You're not running paid social right now
findings.evidence: The public Meta Ad Library shows zero active ads. For a brand at your catalog depth, that's unclaimed demand, and a cold-audience paid engine is the fastest lever we pull.

findings.title: No visible reviews on the page paid traffic hits
findings.evidence: We couldn't find review markup on your product page. Cold paid traffic converts on social proof, so surfacing reviews on the PDP is a direct conversion lever.

findings.title: Email capture is already live where paid traffic lands
findings.evidence: Your storefront shows email capture on the page paid traffic hits. That gives the paid engine an owned audience to bring back and lifts the return on every click you buy.
